title: Exercise Intensity — Borg RPE, Breathlessness Scale, Talk Test and Heart-Rate Reserve

hook.en: Heart rate lies when a patient takes beta-blockers; your ears and the patient's words do not. Learn four ways to set and check intensity and when each one is the right tool.
hook.ur: Beta-blockers lene wale patient mein heart rate jhoot bolti hai; aap ke kaan aur patient ke alfaaz nahi. Intensity set aur check karne ke chaar tareeqay aur har ek kab sahi tool hai seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll use the Borg RPE (6–20), the CR10 breathlessness scale, the talk test and the Karvonen heart-rate reserve method to prescribe and monitor intensity safely.
goal.ur: End tak aap Borg RPE (6–20), CR10 breathlessness scale, talk test aur Karvonen heart-rate reserve method se intensity mehfooz tareeqay se prescribe aur monitor karenge.

text.en: Intensity is how hard the body works. **RPE** (rating of perceived exertion, Borg 6–20) asks "how hard does this feel overall?"; **breathlessness** (modified Borg CR10, 0–10) asks only about the breath; the **talk test** listens to speech; and the **heart-rate reserve** (Karvonen) method calculates a target: **(maximum heart rate − resting heart rate) × percentage + resting heart rate**. Use more than one together, especially when heart rate is unreliable (beta-blockers, atrial fibrillation, pacemaker).
text.ur: Intensity yeh hai ke jism kitni mehnat kar raha hai. **RPE** (rating of perceived exertion, Borg 6–20) poochti hai “overall kitna mushkil lag raha hai?”; **breathlessness** (modified Borg CR10, 0–10) sirf saans ke baare mein poochti hai; **talk test** bolne ko sunta hai; aur **heart-rate reserve** (Karvonen) method target calculate karta hai: **(maximum heart rate − resting heart rate) × percentage + resting heart rate**. Ek se zyada saath use karein, khaas taur par jab heart rate bharosay ki na ho (beta-blockers, atrial fibrillation, pacemaker).

text.en: Heart rate is the car's rev counter, RPE is how hard the driver feels the engine is working, and the talk test is whether the passengers can still chat. A beta-blocker is like a rev limiter: the counter stops rising, but the driver still feels the effort and the passengers still run out of breath. So you trust the driver and the passengers.
text.ur: Heart rate car ka rev counter hai, RPE driver ka ehsaas ke engine kitna mehnat kar raha hai, aur talk test yeh ke passengers abhi baat kar sakte hain ya nahi. Beta-blocker rev limiter jaisa hai: counter barhna band ho jata hai lekin driver ko mehnat mehsoos hoti hai aur passengers ki saans phir bhi phoolti hai. Is liye aap driver aur passengers par bharosa karte hain.

intro.en: Move the slider along the Borg 6–20 scale and read what each number feels like. For most patients we aim for **11–14** ("light" to "somewhat hard"). Notice how the matching talk-test description changes as you move.
intro.ur: Slider ko Borg 6–20 scale par hilayein aur parhein ke har number kaisa lagta hai. Zyada tar patients ke liye hum **11–14** (“light” se “somewhat hard”) ka target rakhte hain. Dekhein ke slider hilane par matching talk-test ki wazahat kaise badalti hai.

intro.en: Show the scale **before** the exercise (6 = no exertion, 20 = maximal), then ask during effort: "How hard does this feel **overall** — legs, breathing, effort?" For most patients aim for 11–14; stop and review above 17 or with symptoms.
intro.ur: Exercise se **pehle** scale dikhayein (6 = koi exertion nahi, 20 = maximal), phir effort ke dauran poochein: “**Overall** kitna mushkil lag raha hai — taangein, saans, mehnat?” Zyada tar patients ke liye 11–14 ka target; 17 se upar ya symptoms hon to rok kar review karein.

question.en: A patient on a beta-blocker has a heart rate of 90 during brisk walking but feels it is "hard" (RPE 15) and is breathless. How should you set intensity?
question.ur: Beta-blocker lene wale patient ki tez chalte hue heart rate 90 hai lekin woh isay “hard” (RPE 15) mehsoos karta hai aur saans phoolti hai. Intensity kaise set karein?

text.en: Use RPE and the talk test (aim for 11–14 and speaking in short sentences), not the heart-rate target
text.ur: RPE aur talk test use karein (11–14 aur chhote jumlay bolna), heart-rate target nahi

feedback.en: Yes — beta-blockers blunt the heart-rate response, so percentage-of-maximum targets are unreliable.
feedback.ur: Haan — beta-blockers heart-rate response ko kund karte hain, is liye percentage-of-maximum targets ghair-bharosay ke hain.

text.en: Increase the speed until the heart rate reaches 70% of age-predicted maximum
text.ur: Speed barhayein jab tak heart rate age-predicted maximum ke 70 % tak na pohnche

feedback.en: That would overload a patient whose heart rate is artificially limited.
feedback.ur: Is se woh patient overload hoga jis ki heart rate masnui taur par limited hai.

text.en: Ignore symptoms and follow the monitor
text.ur: Symptoms nazar-andaz kar ke monitor follow karein

intro.en: Explain: 0 = no breathlessness, 10 = the worst you can imagine. Ask about **breathlessness only**, not leg effort, at rest and during exercise. Stop and rest at 7 or more, or if breathlessness is out of proportion to the work.
intro.ur: Samjhayein: 0 = saans ki koi takleef nahi, 10 = jitni bura tasawwur kar sakein. **Sirf saans phoolne** ke baare mein poochein, taangon ki mehnat ke baare mein nahi, aaraam mein aur exercise ke dauran. 7 ya zyada par ya jab saans kaam ke mutabiq na ho to rok kar rest karein.

intro.en: **Light:** the patient can talk in full sentences, even sing. **Moderate:** can talk but not sing, in short sentences — the target zone. **Too hard:** only a few words between breaths — slow down. Ask "Can you finish a sentence?" during the work.
intro.ur: **Halka:** patient poore jumlay bol sakta hai, gaa bhi sakta hai. **Moderate:** baat kar sakta hai lekin gaa nahi sakta, chhote jumlay — yahi target zone hai. **Bohat mushkil:** saans ke beech sirf chand lafz — raftar kam karein. Kaam ke dauran poochein “kya aap jumla poora kar sakte hain?”

title.ur: Intensity set karne ke chaar tareeqay

rows.en: Any patient who can understand the scale; unaffected by beta-blockers
rows.ur: Har patient jo scale samajh sake; beta-blockers se mutasir nahi

rows.en: Lung disease and heart failure, to separate breathing from leg effort
rows.ur: Phephron ki bimari aur heart failure, saans ko taangon ki mehnat se alag karne ke liye

rows.en: Can talk, not sing, short sentences
rows.ur: Baat kar sakta hai, gaa nahi sakta, chhote jumlay

rows.en: Quick and free; less exact in some conditions
rows.ur: Tez aur muft; kuch halaton mein kam durust

rows.en: About 40–59 % of reserve for moderate, 60–89 % for vigorous
rows.ur: Moderate ke liye reserve ka takriban 40–59 %, vigorous ke liye 60–89 %

rows.en: Not reliable with beta-blockers, AF, pacemakers or in older adults (age-predicted maximum is rough)
rows.ur: Beta-blockers, AF, pacemakers ya buzurgon mein bharosay ka nahi (age-predicted maximum takreeban hota hai)

text.en: **Using 220 minus age as a hard limit.** The age-predicted maximum (220 − age) has a large error (±10–12 beats per minute) and may be wrong by more in older adults and in people with heart or lung disease. Using it as a ceiling can either overload a fit older person or under-dose a deconditioned one. Use it only as a rough guide, add RPE and the talk test and let symptoms decide. Another trap: forgetting to explain the scale before exercise, so the numbers are guessed.
text.ur: **220 minus age ko sakht hadd ki tarah use karna.** Age-predicted maximum (220 − age) mein bara error (±10–12 beats per minute) hai aur buzurgon aur dil ya phephron ki bimari wale logon mein is se bhi zyada ghalat ho sakta hai. Isay chhat ki tarah use karne se fit buzurg par bojh ya deconditioned shakhs ko kam dose mil sakti hai. Isay sirf mota andaza samjhein, RPE aur talk test jorein aur symptoms ko faisla karne dein. Ek aur jaal: exercise se pehle scale na samjhana, is se numbers andaze se diye jate hain.

question.en: Which statement about the talk test is correct for moderate intensity?
question.ur: Moderate intensity ke liye talk test ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?

text.en: The patient can talk but not sing; they speak in short sentences
text.ur: Patient baat kar sakta hai lekin gaa nahi sakta; chhote jumlay bolta hai

feedback.en: Yes — full sentences with singing is light; only a few words is too hard.
feedback.ur: Haan — gaane ke saath poore jumlay halka hai; sirf chand lafz bohat mushkil.

text.en: The patient cannot speak at all

text.ur: Patient aaram se gaa sakta hai

text.en: **Prescribe in words the patient can use.** "Walk so that you can talk in short sentences but not sing, and it feels like 12–13 on this scale." For a cardiac or lung patient add a breathlessness ceiling ("no more than 4 out of 10") and symptom rules (stop for chest pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness). Re-check intensity each session, because fitness changes: as the patient improves, the same RPE is reached at a higher workload.
text.ur: **Aise alfaaz mein prescribe karein jo patient istemal kar sake.** “Aise chalein ke chhote jumlay bol saken lekin gaa na saken, aur is scale par 12–13 lage.” Dil ya phephron ke patient ke liye breathlessness ki hadd jorein (“10 mein se 4 se zyada nahi”) aur symptom rules (seene ke dard, chakkar ya ghair-mamooli saans par rok dein). Har session mein intensity dobara check karein kyunke fitness badalti hai: patient behtar ho to wohi RPE zyada workload par milti hai.

text.en: RPE, breathlessness and the talk test correlate well with the **ventilatory thresholds** and are validated for prescribing intensity in healthy adults, cardiac rehabilitation and chronic lung disease. The "talk test" threshold lines up with the first ventilatory threshold, and an RPE of 11–14 corresponds to roughly 40–60% of heart-rate reserve in many groups. They are most helpful when heart rate is unreliable, but patients must be taught the scale first.
text.ur: RPE, breathlessness aur talk test **ventilatory thresholds** ke saath achi tarah correlate karte hain aur healthy adults, cardiac rehabilitation aur chronic lung disease mein intensity prescribe karne ke liye validated hain. “Talk test” ki hadd pehle ventilatory threshold se milti hai, aur 11–14 RPE bohat se groups mein takriban 40–60 % heart-rate reserve ke barabar hai. Yeh tab sab se zyada madadgar hain jab heart rate bharosay ki na ho, lekin patients ko pehle scale sikhana zaroori hai.

question.en: A patient's resting pulse is 70 and age-predicted maximum is 150. Using Karvonen, what heart rate is 50% of reserve?
question.ur: Patient ki aaraam ki pulse 70 aur age-predicted maximum 150 hai. Karvonen se reserve ka 50 % kaun si heart rate hai?

answer.en: Reserve = 150 − 70 = 80. 50% of 80 = 40. Add the resting rate: 40 + 70 = **110 beats per minute**. Treat the figure as a guide (with ±10 error) and confirm it with RPE or the talk test.
answer.ur: Reserve = 150 − 70 = 80. 80 ka 50 % = 40. Resting rate jorein: 40 + 70 = **110 beats per minute**. Is figure ko rehnumai samjhein (±10 error ke saath) aur RPE ya talk test se confirm karein.

question.en: Which tool is best to separate breathing effort from leg effort in a lung patient?
question.ur: Phephron ke patient mein saans ki mehnat ko taangon ki mehnat se alag karne ke liye sab se behtar tool kaun sa hai?

text.en: The modified Borg CR10 breathlessness scale

feedback.en: Yes — it asks specifically about breathlessness.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh khaas taur par saans phoolne ke baare mein poochti hai.

feedback.en: RPE is overall effort and blends breathing and legs.
feedback.ur: RPE overall effort hai aur saans aur taangon ko milati hai.

feedback.en: It does not separate effort types.
feedback.ur: Yeh mehnat ki qismon ko alag nahi karti.

text.en: **Stop exercise** for chest pain or pressure, dizziness or faintness, a sudden unusual breathlessness (CR10 of 7 or more), a pale or blue appearance, an irregular fast heartbeat, a fall in systolic pressure with increasing work, or any request to stop. Check the drug chart: beta-blockers cap the heart rate, antihypertensives and diuretics can cause low pressure after exercise, and insulin or sulfonylureas can cause low blood sugar.
text.ur: **Exercise rok dein** seene ka dard ya dabao, chakkar ya behoshi jaisa ehsaas, achanak ghair-mamooli saans ki takleef (CR10 7 ya zyada), peela ya neela rang, tez ghair-hamwar dhadkan, barhte kaam ke saath systolic pressure girna, ya rokne ki koi bhi darkhwast par. Drug chart dekhein: beta-blockers heart rate ki hadd banate hain, antihypertensives aur diuretics exercise ke baad kam pressure kar sakte hain, aur insulin ya sulfonylureas blood sugar kam kar sakti hain.

summary.en: Intensity can be set with RPE (aim for 11–14), breathlessness (CR10), the talk test (talk, not sing) or heart-rate reserve.
summary.ur: Intensity RPE (11–14), breathlessness (CR10), talk test (baat karein, gaayein nahi) ya heart-rate reserve se set ho sakti hai.

summary.en: Do not trust heart rate on beta-blockers or with AF; 220 − age is only a rough guide with ±10–12 error.
summary.ur: Beta-blockers ya AF mein heart rate par bharosa na karein; 220 − age sirf mota andaza hai jis mein ±10–12 error hai.

summary.en: Teach the scale before exercise, check each session and stop for symptoms regardless of the numbers.
summary.ur: Exercise se pehle scale sikhayein, har session mein check karein aur numbers ki parwah kiye bagair symptoms par rok dein.

front.en: Borg RPE target for most patients?
front.ur: Zyada tar patients ke liye Borg RPE target?

front.en: What does the talk test say about moderate intensity?
front.ur: Moderate intensity ke baare mein talk test kya kehta hai?

back.en: You can talk but not sing, in short sentences.
back.ur: Aap baat kar sakte hain lekin gaa nahi sakte, chhote jumlay.

front.en: When should you stop for breathlessness on CR10?
front.ur: CR10 par saans ke liye kab rokna chahiye?

back.en: At 7 or more, or if breathlessness is out of proportion to the work.
back.ur: 7 ya zyada par, ya jab saans kaam ke mutabiq na ho.
